features.default_selection: branding `default_image`, then the catalog's; else you must pick
features.validated_fields: hostname, username, passphrase, filesystem with composefs
features.requirements_check: its own step, only while a gate is unmet; holds Next; override for RAM and CPU
features.connectivity_check: its own step and on confirm, not for a copy of this computer's system; image registry first; Network settings and Recheck
features.encryption_passphrase: yes (legacy backend); the daemon backend offers no none, and a passphrase only with no TPM 2.0 (with one, the disk is sealed to it and the step does not show)
features.recovery_key: yes: its own step, with a QR code
features.locale_pages: three steps (language, keyboard, time zone), each a search field and a list; listed on confirm; checked by fisherman validate
features.try_or_install: yes: Try quits, Install advances; off live media the page has the welcome copy and no Try button
features.network_page: yes: only when the install needs a download; holds Next while there is no connection
features.prerelease_page: shown for RELEASE_TYPE pre-release or experiment
features.eula_page: shown when the image ships an agreement
features.wipe_or_free: daemon backend: free space or erase; forced erase counts down
features.recovery_key_screen: yes: the key as a label, copy, QR code, acknowledgement; the daemon backend enrols the key on Done
features.handoff_page: daemon backend: the mode from Probe (migrate, soft_reboot, reboot); Continue calls Handoff with no mode; Not now
features.done_try_again: yes: after a failure or a cancel, back to the disk step
features.cancel_install: Cancel button, asks first; cancelled page
features.translatable: strings marked (qsTr, tr); template `i18n/tuna-installer-kde.ts`; CMake compiles `i18n/tuna-installer-kde_fr.ts` to a `.qm` that loads for the locale; catalogs kept current by a check (#300)
features.source_check: confirm step, Selected image card; a blocked source holds Install
features.install_plan: yes: the target disk (model, size, serial; unknown when the disk does not report it) and each device erased, on a card of the confirm step; Install binds the recipe to that disk with `diskIdentity`, and to the plan with `planBinding` when fisherman reports `plan.binding`; without a plan (an older fisherman) the step is as before
features.bootc_store_view: yes, on the confirm step; the system that this computer runs is a second install source there (experimental, never the default, never on live media)
features.source_reuse_progress: yes: a label under the step line; the bar is indeterminate until the first step; the cancel dialog says that the disk does not change
features.done_receipt: yes: install ID and first-boot check, or the reason
features.log_after_failure: log path; the failure page says whether the disk was changed, and when the cleanup failed or timed out
features.recovery_key_not_in_log: yes (log file and clipboard copy redacted)
